jobs.occupation: Talencia Consulting - Data Scientist - Marketing & Audience Analytics
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Data Scientist to transform complex datasets into actionable insights, develop analytical models and contribute to the continuous improvement of data-driven decision-making processes.

You will work with diverse data sources, develop measurement methodologies and ensure the quality, reliability and usability of data across various business applications.
Your responsibilities

• Data Analysis & Modelling: Analyse large datasets, identify trends and develop statistical models to measure audience behaviour, traffic patterns, reach, frequency, audience segmentation and campaign performance.

• Data Quality & Governance: Define and implement data quality rules, monitor data reliability and document analytical methodologies to ensure consistency, transparency and traceability.

• Reporting & Data Visualization: Transform raw data into structured datasets, dashboards and visual reports. Make complex information accessible and actionable for both technical and business stakeholders.

• Data Infrastructure Optimization: Contribute to improving data collection processes and data infrastructure to ensure efficient and reliable information gathering.

What's in it for your ?

• A full-time open-ended contract within a strong international group

• Between 3.500EUR and 4.000EUR GR./mo.

• A full package of benefits (including a company car, group and health insurance plan, bonuses based on performance, extra-legal holiday, set of legal benefits)

• A data-focused position combining statistical modelling, analytics, reporting and data quality.

• The opportunity to work with diverse datasets and contribute to the development of innovative analytical solutions.

• Close collaboration with different business and technical stakeholders.

• Direct reporting to the Data & Insights management team.

If this sounds indeed like your next position, please let us know by applying with your latest CV.

Looking forward !

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

• 5 years of professional experience in Data Science, Data Analytics or a similar position.

• Strong command of Python and advanced SQL.

• Experience with data visualization and reporting solutions, particularly Power BI.

• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications and the ability to quickly adapt to new software and digital tools.

• Interest in AI-driven solutions and the ability to identify opportunities to improve data processes and analytical workflows.

• Strong analytical mindset, attention to detail and a structured approach to problem-solving.

• Ability to manage multiple tools, datasets and projects efficiently (ex. Snowflake, BigQuery or equivalent platforms, APIs, data pipelines or GIT)

• Excellent command of French and Dutch, with a good knowledge of English for presentations and communication with international stakeholders.

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

To strengthen our Supply Chain Team we are looking for a Configuration & Logistics Officer who ensures that for a given engine, the pieces are made available for assembly within the configuration and timeframe agreed with the customer.

Your role:

• You will analyse and provide the logistical needs to complete the engine.
• You read and understand the logistical aspects of the Bill of Work for the engine.
• You detect critical points in the completion process and look for an appropriate solution to achieve the objectives (e.g. Standard Exchanges, switches between different engines).
• You direct your internal suppliers (warehouse, backshop, subcontracting, purchasing).
• You complete the modules and ensure that they are prepared according to the predetermined production planning.
• You support the assembly line with missing and/or defective parts.
• You analyse the interchangeability (technical and qualitative) of pieces, in accordance with the established configuration.

Your profile:

• You have a Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain or a technical direction, or equivalent through experience.
• You have an interest in aircraft engines and want to learn more about them.
• You are communicative and dare to ask questions.
• You work in a structured, accurate and proactive way.
• You work analytically and come up with practical solutions.
• You organize, divide and control your work independently.
• You speak French or Dutch, you also have a good knowledge of technical English.
• Experience with SAP is a plus.
• You work in shifts, from Monday to Friday (6 am - 2 pm, 2 pm - 10 pm).
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

The ATE Test Development Engineer is responsible for the ATE test implementation and optimization making use of our ATE test setup. From the initial ASIC development kick-off until end of life, the ATE Test Development Engineer will be responsible for defining ATE test software and supporting the launch of new products into high volume production. Together with the test engineers in our bench test lab, the ATE Test Development Engineer keeps a clear overview, ensuring a strong overall test methodology. This position is part of the product engineering group of ICsense and cooperates with cross-functional teams of Test engineers, Design (DFT), Product Engineering, Reliability, Foundry.
 

Responsibilities
 
 

• Responsible for the implementation and performance of production tests of ICsense ASICs, taking into account quality and test performance 
 

• Set up, implementation, debug and optimization of test programs for automated testing 

• Work with ICsense test engineers to correlate bench test results and ATE test results for debug, characterization, … 

• Ensure the test program is scalable (multi-site), re-usable and accurate (GR&R)   

• Drive continuous improvements to product quality and customer satisfaction throughout the lifecycle of the product 
 

• Investigate ATE test setup related problems, find the root cause and propose ATE test setup/software adaptations to the project team to overcome these problems 

• Work on yield improvement/test time reduction programs together with the product quality team   

Competencies
 
 

• You have a Master degree in Industrial engineering 

• You have at least 3 years of experience in ATE test development 

• Background with ATE test development software is required 

• Experience with one of the main ATE programming languages is required: VBA, C++ or Java 

• Team player with a strong sense of urgency to meet test requirements on schedule 

• You communicate fluently in English (oral and written)

Senior Accountant (m/v/x) - Shared Service Center (German-speaking) - Brussels

 

On behalf of our client, a leading international group in energy infrastructure, Robert Half is looking for a Senior Accountant for its newly established Shared Service Center in central Brussels.

 

 

Your role

• You are end-to-end responsible for a number of Belgian and German entities, from transactions and reconciliations through to closing.
• You handle the month-, quarter- and year-end closings: GL, payroll and tax accounting, and complex entries (BEGAAP / GEGAAP / IFRS).
• You calculate and book the IFRS adjustments, and carry out reconciliations and analytical reviews.
• You perform the intercompany reconciliations and follow up on differences.
• You do the periodic reporting (local GAAP and IFRS) to local teams, business controllers and Group Finance.
• You are the point of contact for auditors, tax authorities and Group functions.
• You help roll out SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud: process design, testing, documentation and training.
• You contribute to process improvement and standardisation, and act as back-up within the SSC.
 

Your profile

• You hold a bachelor's degree in accounting/finance. A recognised accountancy qualification is a plus.
• You have at least 4 years of experience in GL, closing and reporting, ideally in a multi-entity or international environment.
• You have hands-on knowledge of BEGAAP and/or GEGAAP and IFRS.
• You are proficient in SAP. Experience with S/4HANA or Public Cloud is a strong plus.
• You speak fluent English and good German. French or Dutch is a plus.
• You are autonomous, structured, service-minded and comfortable with change.

You’ll follow established timeframes, adhere to safety regulations, and work closely with your colleagues and the workshop supervisor.

Are you a team player with strong technical insight and a passion for trucks? Apply today and help shape tomorrow’s mobility!

Is cybersecurity in your blood? Do you enjoy translating complex designs and business risks into clear, tailored security solutions? Are you experienced in positioning Security Operations Center (SOC), Managed Security Services and Security Technologies in complex, consultative sales cycles? Then this senior role could be the right next step for you. Within the Cegeka Security & Networking division, we help organizations improve their cyber resilience through end-to-end cybersecurity services covering assessment and advisory, protection, detection and response, and recovery. To support the continued growth of our global Security Solution Presales team, we are recruiting a Security Presales Architect based in Belgium. As part of the global team, you will support both Belgian and international customers, collaborating across countries with sales teams, security specialists and delivery experts on local and international opportunities.

 

• You discover and qualify customer security objectives, threat exposure, regulatory drivers, operational challenges and requirements, and translate them into a coherent security solution architecture and service proposition.
• You position and present Cegeka SOC, MDR and managed security services, clearly articulating customer outcomes, scope, operating model, service integration and value.
• You design security solutions across SIEM, XDR, endpoint, identity, cloud and threat detection, with Microsoft security technologies as an important part of the solution landscape.
• You lead the security presales workstream for complex opportunities, from initial discovery and workshops through solution design, presentations, demonstrations, proposal development, negotiation support and handover.
• You respond to RFI, RFP and tender requirements, including solution descriptions, assumptions, service scope, effort and cost inputs, risk identification and compliance mapping.
• You develop customer-specific business cases, transformation roadmaps and commercial solution options in cooperation with sales, service owners, product management and delivery teams.
• You coordinate contributions from SOC, Architects, Advisors and other subject-matter experts to create one integrated customer proposition.
• You ensure a structured handover of the agreed solution, scope, assumptions, dependencies and commitments to delivery and operational teams.
• You act as a senior subject-matter expert and trusted security advisor, taking ownership of keeping your security expertise up to date through strategic vendor engagement, relevant certifications and continuous awareness of evolving cyber threats and technologies.
• You identify market developments, customer needs and competitive insights, and translate these into actionable feedback for service owners and product management.
• You contribute to reusable proposal content, value propositions, sales enablement and solution templates, and drive continuous improvement through standardization, automation and AI-enabled pre-sales tools and templates.
What you need to succeed:
• At least 7 years of relevant cybersecurity experience, including substantial experience in senior solution presales, security architecture, security consulting or a comparable customer-facing role.
• Proven customer-facing presales experience is mandatory. You can independently lead discovery, shape solutions, create and defend proposals, present to executive and technical audiences, and guide opportunities through complex decision processes.
• Strong practical knowledge of SOC and Managed Detection & Response services, including the ability to discuss use cases, operating models, onboarding considerations, integrations, service scope and customer responsibilities.
• Strong experience with Microsoft security solutions, such as Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender XDR, Defender for Cloud, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, …
• Experience with relevant strategic security vendors and ecosystems. Knowledge of technologies from vendors such as Microsoft, CrowdStrike, Cisco, Fortinet and Vectra is valuable. Experience with additional SIEM, XDR, endpoint, identity, Network, cloud security and threat platforms is an advantage.
• Good understanding of cyber threats, detection and response, incident handling, threat intelligence, security operations and the business value of managed security services.
• Ability to translate customer requirements and risks into an integrated security solution, service scope, roadmap and commercial proposition aligned with Cegeka’s managed services portfolio.
• Demonstrable experience with RFI/RFP responses, statements of work, assumptions, sizing and pricing inputs, presentations and customer workshops.
• Strong consultative communication, stakeholder management and presentation skills.
• Ability to work autonomously, structure complex information, coordinate virtual bid teams and take ownership of security pre-sales deliverables.
• You are based in Belgium and can work flexibly from Cegeka offices, from home and at customer locations. You are willing to travel when required.
• You will be part of Cegeka’s global Solution Presales organisation. Your primary market is Belgium, while you will also support international teams and global customers and collaborate with colleagues across countries.
• A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree is required, preferably in an IT-related field, complemented by relevant professional experience and security expertise.
• Fluent professional English is required. Professional Dutch is required for the Belgian market, French is a plus.
• Relevant certifications such as CISSP, Microsoft Security certifications or comparable security credentials are considered strong assets.

The school is seeking an passionate Physical Education (PE) Teacher for a late August 2025 start date preferably with a strong background in UK Secondary Education and the Cambridge Curriculum. The successful candidate will be expected to undertake a pastoral role in the school and to contribute to the school's co-curriculum. This role also encompasses curriculum development for our expanding secondary school as we grow organically year by year up to Year 13.  

Key Responsibilities:

	
• Plan and deliver engaging and high-quality P.E. lessons across all key stages (Key Stage 1 - 4).
	
• Teach and support students studying IGCSE P.E., ensuring strong subject knowledge and exam preparation.
	
• Foster a positive and inclusive sporting environment that encourages participation and teamwork.
	
• Develop students' physical skills, fitness, and understanding of healthy lifestyles.
	
• Organise and contribute to extracurricular sports clubs, fixtures, and school sporting events.
	
• Work collaboratively with colleagues to promote a strong sports culture within the school.

 
BJAB is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children. All candidates will be subject to background checks in line with British Overseas Standards.  

Successful candidates must have the following qualifications:  

• Qualified Teacher Status (QTS) 
• Experience teaching IGCSE Physical Education or in a British secondary school or similar educational setting
• Degree in Physical Education or related subject (e.g., sports science, coaching)
• Ability to carry out practical swimming instruction is required
• Experience teaching PE in a British school setting, either in the UK or abroad (desirable)
• An excellent knowledge of UK education and the National Curriculum of England , particularly of the IGCSE P.E. curriculum and assessment
• A passion for promoting health, fitness, and sportsmanship
• Strong subject knowledge and pedagogical skills
• Excellent communication, organisational, and interpersonal skills
• Ability to inspire and motivate students of varying ages and abilities
• Strong communication and organisational skills
• Native or Fluent mastery level of English  
• The right to work in Belgium and/or eligibility for sponsorship under a Belgian work visa programme 
 

Applications without these essential criteria will not be considered. We welcome applications from ECTs for this role. 

The following experience is highly desirable:  

• Teaching experience in Key Stage 3 and/or 4 or (I)GCSE in a British school or a British international school   
• Ability to teach an additional related subjects would be a clear asset 
• Experience of delivering the Duke of Edinburgh program or willingness to be trained to do so would be an additional benefit
This position will begin in August 2027 for an indefinite time. We only welcome candidates interested in full-time employment for this role. If interested, kindly submit the TES application form. The Headteacher, Mr Francis Retter (f.retter@bjab.org) also welcomes a short covering letter and CV. Applications will be considered on a rolling basis and short-listed candidates may be contacted before the advertising end date.
